Temperature 749.6 °C versus 750 °C setpoint, heater power 44.8%, argon 100.1 versus 100 sccm, pressure 3.004 Torr, oxygen 2.7 ppm, and running status are consistent with stable growth execution.
Growth-stage verification is available with no required sensors missing.
